name: Split-Strike Short Combo (OTM Reverse Risk Reversal)
summary: Sell an OTM call and buy an OTM put in the same expiry, typically for near-zero cost; bearish exposure with unlimited upside risk.

legs.strike_rule: OTM put whose premium approximately equals the call credit; usually a lower delta than the call because put skew makes puts pricier.

max_profit: (put strike * 100) - net cost, as the underlying approaches zero
max_loss: UNDEFINED -- unlimited above the short call strike
breakevens: if opened flat: below = put strike; above = call strike, adjusted by the net debit/credit

greeks.gamma: positive below the put strike, negative above the call strike
greeks.vega: near zero at entry; long vega below, short vega above

when_to_use: Bearish exposure financed by selling an upside call -- the mirror of the long combo. Skew works AGAINST you here: you buy the expensive put with the cheap call's credit, so the zero-cost put strike ends up uncomfortably far away.
entry_rules: BLOCKED ON THIS ACCOUNT. The short call is uncovered -- Level 4, unavailable on Alpaca, rejected by the MLeg covered-legs rule.
Defined-risk substitute: sell a bear CALL SPREAD and use the credit to buy a put or put spread, as two separate Level 3 MLeg orders.

If it were enabled: net cost between -$0.05 and +$0.05; short call 0.20-0.30 delta; DTE 45-90; and an explicit check that the resulting put strike is within 1.5 ATR(20) of spot, otherwise the hedge is decorative.
Sizing would have to assume unlimited upside risk -- there is no correct size for that on a $50k account.
management_rules: If enabled: take profit when the long put reaches 2x entry value or the underlying breaks 1.5 ATR below the put strike.
Stop: close if the underlying trades above the short call strike.
Never roll the short call up and out on a running underlying.
exit_rules: Flat by 15:45 ET on expiration day.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close the short call whenever it is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10, and unconditionally if the underlying is above (call strike - $0.05) at 15:30 ET on expiry day.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before ex-dividend whenever the short call is ITM and extrinsic < 1.5 * dividend.
assignment_risk: The short call is uncovered. Assignment creates short stock (100 shares per contract) plus a dividend obligation on payers. The long put caps nothing above the call strike.
buying_power: Reg-T naked call margin less the long put premium. Not available on Alpaca.
common_mistakes: Assuming skew symmetry with the long combo; underestimating how far out the financed put ends up; holding a short call through a squeeze.
zero_dte_notes: Not permitted and structurally pointless at 0DTE.
family: Two-leg verticals and same-expiry two-leg combos (call/put verticals, straddles, strangles, guts, synthetics/risk reversals, ratio verticals and backspreads)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
